This story is a literature review relating to goal 6 of the United Nation's Sustainable Development Goals. This goal seeks to ensure access to safe drinking water and sanitation for all. In this story I explore news articles as well as scholarly journals in order to glean a better picture of literature surrounding this topic. With access to safe water and sanitation being a prerequisite to physical health, understanding the current picture and pathways forward for this goal is of utmost importance. Water is undeniably a human right and it is not until everyone has safe access to it that they can be fully involved in other areas of sustainable development.

For the full story, go here: <https://foxredmond.github.io/data_story_3.0/intro.html> (<https://github.com/foxredmond/data_story_3.0>)
